newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet gains on IPE, premiums under pressure.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet gains on IPE, premiums under pressure.

text.p: Jet fuel prices in Europe gained on stronger IPE gas oil futures on Friday and premiums were steady amid plentiful supply, traders said.

Nov IPE gas oil futures ended $6.25 firmer at $233.75 a tonne. Jet barge premiums were steady at Nov IPE +$32/34. Cargoes were also unchanged at Nov IPE +$29/31, but traders said plentiful supply from the Mideast Gulf and Carribean was putting pressure on premiums. Buyers balked at prices in the Med, with some heard at around $4 below recent premiums.
